notes: Account: SableBridge - risk/treasury platform for institutional customers.
Primary ask: enterprise-grade code assistant integrated into internal IDE (JetBrains + VS Code) with streaming completions and sub-50ms char latency for local agents.
Must support model/version pinning per team and rollback strategy for regressions.
Data controls: strict retention policies, ability to purge customer prompts, audit trail for all model calls.
Security: SSO/SAML SSO via Okta, SCIM required for provisioning, HSM-backed KMS, SOC2/ISO27001 expected.
Network: prefer Private deployment (VPC) with optional on-prem runner for secret clearance teams. No external internet access from on-prem agents.
Integration: want IDE plugin with streaming token-by-token update, ability to disable streaming per policy, and local latency telemetry exposed to Redwood Console.
Scale: initial pilot ~120 devs, ramp to ~1,200 across 3 global regions in 12 months. Throughput expectations ~150 reqs/s peak for completions + background batch for code search embeddings.
Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay premium for guaranteed latency & auditability but want Optimize recommendations to reduce token spend.
Quote from CTO on call: "We need deterministic inference — if latency spikes, we need automatic fallback to a pinned, smaller model."
Requested deliverables: security FAQ answers, deployment network diagram, POC SOW, pricing for Dedicated reserved pool + Private licensing.
Short-term next steps: Redwood to return completed security questionnaire, schedule POC kickoff (2-hour design session), provide estimated resource footprint for on-prem runners.
workload_summary: Primary workload: developer IDE copilot (context-window: file + repo + project metadata).
Secondary: CI/PR assistant for automated code suggestions and pre-merge checks (needs non-blocking async reranking).
Latency target: median token latency <50ms in IDE streaming; end-to-end suggestion generation <300ms for short completions.
Throughput target: 150 reqs/s peak for interactive completions; embeddings batch jobs 2000 docs/night.
Model requirements: ability to pin exact model artifact/version per team; signatures for reproducible outputs; fallbacks to quantized variants when capacity constrained.
Observability: token-level cost, latency histograms by route/model, and per-request audit ids forwarded to S3 for compliance retention.
